purpose: Determine whether the Amado et al. 2018 New World anuran SVL dataset can provide an independent high-coverage body-size validation for the fixed 29-species NAAMP response family.

source.documented_scope: SVL of 1233 anuran species from the New World

allowed_outputs: for text-like columns: number of fixed NAAMP species names matched by exact/frozen-alias normalization
best structural species-name column and matched/unmatched species list
prohibited_outputs: any association between SVL and wet recruitment
any effect estimate or p-value involving body size

taxonomy.aliases: same frozen Hyla<->Dryophytes and Lithobates<->Rana only

decision.usable_if: one unique sheet/column yields >=15 matched NAAMP species and workbook contains an unambiguous SVL-like numeric column; final validation contract must still be frozen before body-size effect readback
decision.stop_if: download inaccessible or no structural species column reaches 15 matches
